stageScopes.totalProductMeasurementMs: normal Product measurement; it overlaps all independent diagnostics

stageScopes.workerStartTransferOverheadEstimateMs: max(0, workerRoundtripMs - workerAdapterAndPortAnalysisMs) from the same Worker operation
